name: Background Check
description: Runs a capability health check as a backend-owned task: check_start returns a task id at once, the checks run outside any invoke, and check_status / check_list return the task's complete current state.
_comment: Publish metadata (slug/name/version/executa_type) is read by `anna-app apps publish`; the dev fields (tool_id/type/enabled) are read by `anna-app dev`. This dir is the `background-check` handle referenced by app.json#bundled_executas. To ship an installable binary, add a `binary` profile with binary_urls (see anna-app-llm-demo for the full pattern).
